description: Use this when you need the sub-accounts created by the signed-in parent, including each inbox quota and how many inboxes are in use. Read-only; requires auth; no inputs. Returns {data:[{id, name, inbox_quota, account_id, api_key_prefix, inboxes_used, created_at}]}. Does not return API keys.
name: cooper_list_workspaces

outputSchema.description: Workspaces under this account. API keys are not returned.

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

api_key.description: Workspace API key, returned only once on create. Never repeat it in full.

api_key_prefix.description: First characters of the workspace key, for display.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

inbox_quota.description: Most inboxes the workspace may hold.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: List sub-accounts
